hebrewText: וּ/בַרְזִלַּי֙ הַ/גִּלְעָדִ֔י יָרַ֖ד מֵ/רֹגְלִ֑ים וַ/יַּעֲבֹ֤ר אֶת הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֔ן לְ/שַׁלְּח֖/וֹ אֶת ב/ירדן הַ/יַּרְדֵּֽן

tokens.bdb: to descend (literally, to go downwards; or conventionally to a lower region, as the shore, a boundary, the enemy, etc.; or figuratively, to fall); causatively, to bring down (in all the above applications)

to cross over; used very widely of any transition (literal or figurative; transitive, intransitive, intensive, causative); specifically, to cover (in copulation)
